text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, no, it's nothing. I just haven't
been
sleeping well of late.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски found me taking a nap the
other day.
She says I was talking in my
sleep about student
council business.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Even in my dreams, I have no respite
from my
duties, it seems.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that's why I feel as though I've
hardly
slept at all. Frankly, I struggle to
discern whether
I'm dreaming or awake.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Симболи Рудольф's lack of
proper
sleep is becoming a real
problem...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
